segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ חַלּוֹן שֶׁבֵּין שְׁתֵּי חֲצֵירוֹת אַרְבָּעָה עַל אַרְבָּעָה, בְּתוֹךְ עֲשָׂרָה — מְעָרְבִין שְׁנַיִם. וְאִם רָצוּ — מְעָרְבִין אֶחָד.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If there is «a window» in a wall that separates «between two courtyards,» and the window measures «four by four» handbreadths and is «within ten» handbreadths of the ground, the inhabitants of the courtyards «establish two eiruvin,» one for each courtyard. «And if they desire, they» may «establish one eiruv,» thereby merging the two courtyards, as they may be considered as one due to the window.

segments.he: פָּחוֹת מֵאַרְבָּעָה עַל אַרְבָּעָה אוֹ לְמַעְלָה מֵעֲשָׂרָה מְעָרְבִין שְׁנַיִם, וְאֵין מְעָרְבִין אֶחָד.
segments.en: However, if the window measures «less than four by four» handbreadths, or if it is «above ten» handbreadths from the ground, it is no longer considered a valid opening, and the two courtyards cannot be considered a single courtyard. Therefore, the residents «establish two eiruvin, but they» may «not establish one eiruv.»

moves.summary: a 4x4 window within ten: two eiruvin, or one if they wish
smaller or above ten: two eiruvin only

positions.claim: a 4x4 window within ten handbreadths allows one or two eiruvin; smaller or higher requires two
